question: Two cars start from the same point and travel in the same direction. If one car travels at a speed of 55 km/h and the other at 72 km/h, how far apart will they be after 3 hours?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Same direction ⇒ relative speed = difference of speeds

Relative speed = 72 − 55 = 17 km/hr

Distance after 3 hours = 17 × 3 = 51 km

**∴ Answer = 51 km**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of car 1 = 55 km/hr

Speed of car 2 = 72 km/hr

Time = 3 hours

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance covered by first car = 55 × 3 = 165 km

⇒ Distance covered by second car = 72 × 3 = 216 km

⇒ Distance between them = 216 − 165 = 51 km

**∴ The correct answer is 51 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Same direction ⇒ subtract speeds

Distance Formula

Distance = Speed × Time

Key Concept

Distance between moving objects depends on relative speed

Exam Tip

Use relative speed for faster calculation
